ghGetFileContent.name: ghGetFileContent
ghGetFileContent.description:
## Read file content
  <when>
  - Use when you need details from a known file path.
  - Supports partial ranges or full file reading.
  </when>
  <fromTool>
   - self: Read more context by expanding 'startLine'/'endLine' or 'matchStringContextLines'.
   - ghSearchCode: Search for context from findings (imports, patterns, functions, objects).
   - ghViewRepoStructure: Get context from file discovered by structure.
   - ghSearchRepos: Find usage in other repositories.
   - npmSearch: Check dependencies/imports repo locations (then use ghSearchRepos).
   - ghSearchPRs: Read PR/commit data related to file.
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - Choose one strategy: 'startLine' + 'endLine' OR 'matchString' OR 'fullContent'.
  - Token efficiency: Use 'fullContent' only if the whole file is needed (small files).
  - File size limit: 300KB max. Larger files return FILE_TOO_LARGE error.
  - Branch: For pagination, use branch NAME (e.g. "main"), not commit SHA (which changes).
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - matchString="somePattern", matchStringContextLines=20
  - startLine=1, endLine=20 (known location)
  - fullContent=true (small configs only)
  </examples>

schema.branch: Branch, tag, or SHA (optional; defaults to repository default branch)
schema.path: Full file path from repository root. Path format: no leading slash, exact case (e.g., "src/api/auth.ts")
schema.startLine: Start line number for partial read (used with endLine)
schema.endLine: End line number for partial read (used with startLine)
schema.fullContent: Return entire file content (default: false, token expensive)
schema.matchString: Search pattern to extract from matching sections in file (used with matchStringContextLines)
schema.matchStringContextLines: Lines of context around 'matchString' matches (1-50, default: 5)
schema.charOffset: Starting character offset for pagination (default: 0). Use charOffset + charLength from previous response to get next page.
schema.charLength: Maximum characters to return per page (default: 20000, ~5K tokens). Content exceeding this is auto-paginated.
schema.minified: DEPRECATED - Minification now automatic, parameter ignored
schema.sanitize: DEPRECATED - Sanitization removed, no longer needed
schema.addTimestamp: DEPRECATED - Timestamp info now always included in response
schema.parameterConflict: DEPRECATED - Conflict detection removed, no longer needed

hasResults: Reuse owner/repo/branch/path from response for related fetches
For pagination: use branch NAME, not commit SHA
Trace imports → ghSearchCode / npmSearch
Understand Content! Get more context of the file using startLine/endLine or larger matchStringContextLines
Use matchString to reduce tokens on large files
empty: Invalid path? Use ghViewRepoStructure or ghSearchCode match="path"
Branch not found? Omit param or try main/master
404? Check case sensitivity - paths are case-sensitive
FILE_TOO_LARGE? Use matchString or startLine/endLine

ghSearchCode.name: ghSearchCode
ghSearchCode.description:
## Search file content or files by path
  <when>
  - Find code patterns | Locate files | Discovery
  - Find File (`match="path"`), Find Pattern (`match="file"`)
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Refine query | Try semantic variants | Switch `match="path"↔"file"` (BFS/DFS)
  - ghGetFileContent: Read full content of found matches
  - ghViewRepoStructure: Locate file in directory tree
  - ghSearchRepos: Find other repositories
  - ghSearchPRs: Find history/blame for file
  - npmSearch: Check imported packages
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - FILTERS: 1-2 filters safe. 3+ filters risky. NEVER combine extension+filename+path (returns empty).
  - PATHS: Strict prefix matching. `path:pkg` finds `pkg/file`, NOT `parent/pkg/file`. Verify with ghViewRepoStructure.
  - AVOID: Broad terms | Finding package repos (use `npmSearch`).
  - Start lean: single filter → verify results → add one filter at a time.
  - Prefer specifying owner & repo for precision and cost.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - owner="facebook", repo="react", match="path", keywordsToSearch=["utils"]
  - owner="facebook", repo="react", keywordsToSearch=["useState"], match="file", limit=10
  - owner="facebook", repo="react", path="src/api", extension="ts", keywordsToSearch=["export"]
  </examples>

schema.keywordsToSearch: Search terms (1-5 required) applied with AND logic. Behavior depends on match parameter: match="file" searches file content and returns text_matches[], match="path" searches file/directory names only
schema.owner: Optional repo owner (e.g., "bgauryy"). Omit for cross-repo discovery
schema.repo: Optional repo name (e.g., "octocode-mcp"). Use with owner to scope results
schema.extension: File extension without dot (e.g., ts, js, py)
schema.filename: Filename pattern for case-insensitive substring matching
schema.path: Directory path (e.g. "src/components"). Strict: matches files in dir, not parent/dir.
schema.match: "file" (content only), "path" (filenames only). If omitted, searches both (content AND filenames).
schema.page: Page number for pagination (1-10, default: 1). GitHub limits to 1000 total results (10 pages × 100 per page max).
schema.stars: DEPRECATED - Use ghSearchRepos for star-based filtering
schema.minify: DEPRECATED - Minification now automatic, parameter ignored
schema.sanitize: DEPRECATED - Sanitization removed, no longer needed

hasResults: Use `repositoryContext` for all ghGetFileContent calls when available
Pass `text_matches` to ghGetFileContent matchString for targeted reads
Trace imports/dependencies with new searches to follow code flow
empty: extension+filename+path together = ALWAYS fails - remove one
For package repos → npmSearch
Try opposite match mode (file↔path) or semantic variants

singleRepo: Single repo: use `repositoryContext` directly for all calls
multiRepo: Multi-repo: extract owner/repo from each file's `repo` field
Consider narrowing to specific repo for targeted results

ghSearchPRs.name: ghSearchPRs
ghSearchPRs.description:
## Search or fetch Pull Requests (metadata, diffs, discussions)
  <when>
  - Implementation history | Review changes | Find changes
  - Workflow: Review PR Meta (type=metadata) → Check specific diff (type=partialContent)
  - Use type=fullContent on small PRs only
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - SELF: Refine query | Try semantic variants | Check related PRs | Widen date range.
  - Other: Find changes or known issues in repository
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - AVOID: Fetching large changes (fullContent - token-heavy)
  - prNumber ignores all other filters.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - prNumber=123, type="metadata" (specific PR)
  - owner="org", repo="repo", state="closed", merged=true, limit=3
  - prNumber=123, type="partialContent", partialContentMetadata=[{"file": "src/app.ts"}]
  </examples>

schema.query: Free-text search query across PR title, body, and comments (max 256 characters)
schema.prNumber: Direct PR number for fetching specific PR
schema.author: Creator/author of the content
schema.label: Label filter
schema.head: Source branch
schema.comments: Comment count filter with comparison operators (e.g., ">5", "10..20")
schema.reactions: Reaction count filter with comparison operators
schema.interactions: Combined comments and reactions count filter
schema.match: Fields to search (OR logic): ["title"|"body"|"comments"]. Default: all fields
schema.withCommits: Include commit details with file changes
schema.type: Content type (default: 'metadata'): 'metadata' (file list only, no patches), 'fullContent' (all patches - token-heavy, small PRs only), 'partialContent' (specific files - REQUIRES partialContentMetadata)
schema.partialContentMetadata: Array of file objects. Simple: [{"file": "src/app.ts"}]. With line filters: [{"file": "path", "additions": [1,2], "deletions": [5]}]

hasResults: Use `file_changes[].filename` with ghGetFileContent for full context
Use `base_ref` to see state before changes
Extract keywords from patches → ghSearchCode for similar patterns
empty: Know PR number? Use prNumber directly - bypasses all filters
Remove most restrictive filters first (specific author/dates → state → labels)
Switch query ↔ author/label filters

ghSearchRepos.name: ghSearchRepos
ghSearchRepos.description:
## Search repositories by keywords/topics
  <when>
  - Starting research | Finding repos | Discovering projects
  - Use keywords in organizations and topics for public (open-source)
  - AVOID: Known package → use 'npmSearch' FIRST
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Refine query | Try semantic variants | Switch topics↔keywords
  - ghSearchCode: Found code ref? Search for origin repo
  - ghGetFileContent: Found readme/manifest? Search for origin repo
  - ghSearchPRs: Found PR? Search for base repo
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - After finding repo: use 'ghViewRepoStructure' or 'ghSearchCode' for discovery
  - Matches against: Name, Description, and README (use 'match' param to filter)
  - Freshness: Check 'pushedAt' in response (last code change) > 'updatedAt' (meta change)
  - Public Repos: Use 'stars' >1000 to filter noise (Caution: may hide very new projects)
  - Topics: Use to find related open-source projects (combine with keywords)
  - Synonyms: Try variants (e.g. "auth" vs "authentication", "ai" vs "llm")
  - Auto-filtering: Archived repositories are excluded automatically
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - topicsToSearch=["typescript", "cli"], stars=">1000" (public projects)
  - keywordsToSearch=["someRepoInOrg"]
  </examples>

schema.keywordsToSearch: Keywords applied with AND logic across repository name, description, and README
schema.topicsToSearch: Exact GitHub topic tags for curated search (e.g., ["typescript", "cli"])
schema.owner: Optional repo owner/org to scope results (e.g., "wix-private")
schema.size: Repository size in KB with comparison operators (e.g., ">1000", "<500")
schema.updated: Last metadata update filter (description, settings changes - NOT code pushes). Format: ">=YYYY-MM-DD"
schema.match: Restrict search to specific fields: ["name"|"description"|"readme"]. WARNING: Very restrictive when combined with other filters - try omitting for broader results.
schema.sort: Sort by: stars | forks | updated | best-match
schema.page: Page number for pagination (1-10, default: 1). GitHub limits to 1000 total results (10 pages × 100 per page max).
schema.pushed: DEPRECATED - Use 'updated' parameter for activity filtering

hasResults: Use `owner` + `repo` with ghViewRepoStructure or ghSearchCode
Use `defaultBranch` for subsequent calls to avoid branch errors
Check `pushedAt` - older than 1 year = likely stale
High `openIssuesCount`? Check ghSearchPRs for recent fixes
empty: For package repos, use npmSearch instead (npm/PyPI)
Using `match`? It's very restrictive - try removing it first
Multiple filters? Remove one at a time: match → dates → stars → size
Topics not matching? Try keywords or vice versa
Try synonyms: "server"→"backend", "plugin"→"extension"

topicsHasResults: Topics are broad - verify relevance with ghViewRepoStructure or README
topicsEmpty: Try broader topics or switch to keywordsToSearch
keywordsEmpty: Switch to topicsToSearch for category-based discovery
keywordsHasResults: Keywords matched - verify with ghViewRepoStructure or README

ghViewRepoStructure.name: ghViewRepoStructure
ghViewRepoStructure.description:
## Display directory structure
  <when>
  - Understand repo structure (layout, configs, implementations) | Discover file paths.
  - Workflow: Map Root (`depth=1`) → Drill Down (`path` + `depth=2`) → Locate Files.
  </when>
  <output>
  - Returns `structure`: Record<dirPath, {files: string[], folders: string[]}>
  - Returns `summary`: {totalFiles, totalFolders, truncated, filtered, originalCount}
  - Keys are relative paths ("." = root, "src" = src/)
  - Auto-filters: 85+ directories (.git, node_modules, dist, build, etc.)
  - Truncation: Max 200 items (50 per depth level). Check summary.truncated
  </output>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Drill into subdirectory | Explore sibling paths.
  - ghSearchCode | ghGetFileContent: Search/Read file from found path.
  - ghSearchRepos | npmSearch: Initial exploration entry point.
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - Avoid unknown paths (use root with depth=1 first).
  - `depth=2` is slow on large dirs (use on specific subdirectories).
  - Monorepos: Check `packages/` or `apps/` individually.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - path="", depth=1 (root overview)
  - path="src", depth=2 (drill down)
  - path="packages/core", depth=1 (monorepo package)
  </examples>

schema.branch: Branch/tag/SHA (REQUIRED). First call: use 'main' or 'master', or get defaultBranch from ghSearchRepos
schema.path: Directory path to explore (empty string or omit for root directory)
schema.depth: Exploration depth: 1 (current directory only) or 2 (includes subdirectories). Default: 1
schema.entriesPerPage: Number of entries (files + folders) per page. Default: 50, Max: 200

hasResults: Check `summary.truncated` - if true, use pagination or narrow path
Use `branch` field for subsequent ghGetFileContent calls
Common dirs: src/, lib/, pkg/ (Go), cmd/ (Go), internal/ (Go), app/ (Rails/Laravel), tests/, docs/
empty: Start at root (path="", depth=1) first
Monorepo? Try packages/, apps/, libs/, workspaces/
Branch error? Get defaultBranch from ghSearchRepos first

npmSearch.name: npmSearch
npmSearch.description:
## Find NPM/Python packages & their repository URLs
  <when>
  - Fast lookup of package repository and URL (owner/repo) from package name (prevents research loops)
  - Find entry points and package types for implementation research
  - Researching libraries | Finding dependencies (from imports/config)
  - Workflow: Find Package → Get code location (owner/repo/path) → Explore with other tools
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - SELF: Compare alternatives | Try semantic variants
  - OTHER: Find package location for research (continue with ghViewRepoStructure/ghSearchCode)
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - AVOID: Using `ghSearchCode` or `ghSearchRepos` for package discovery if this tool is available
  - Packages can be found via code imports or config files (e.g. package.json/requirements.txt)
  - Use searchLimit=1 if name known | searchLimit=5 for searching alternatives
  - Python: ALWAYS returns 1 result regardless of searchLimit (PyPI limitation)
  - Python packages often use underscores, NPM uses dashes
  - Python returns `repository` field instead of `repoUrl`
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - ecosystem="npm", name="express" | ecosystem="python", name="requests"
  </examples>

schema.ecosystem: Package registry to search: "npm" for NPM registry, "python" for PyPI
schema.name: Package name or search term to find
schema.searchLimit: Maximum results for NPM queries (1-10). Python always returns 1 result. Default: 1
schema.npmFetchMetadata: Whether to fetch detailed metadata for NPM packages (slower but more info). Note: Deprecation status is ALWAYS checked for NPM packages.
schema.pythonFetchMetadata: Fetch full metadata (version, description, keywords, author, license)

hasResults: Check DEPRECATED warnings first - they appear at top
Use owner/repo fields → ghViewRepoStructure to explore
Compare: version, lastPublished, license for alternatives
empty: Try name variations: dashes ↔ underscores, scoped ↔ unscoped
Fallback → ghSearchCode or ghSearchRepos

localGetFileContent.name: localGetFileContent
localGetFileContent.description:
## Read file content
  <when>
  - Read targeted file sections | Paginated content reading
  - Use when you have a path (from localSearchCode/localFindFiles). Not for discovery.
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - localSearchCode: Get specific lines/context from search results
  - localFindFiles: Read content of discovered files
  - self: Pagination (charOffset) | Expand context
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - AVOID: fullContent on large files without charLength (token heavy).
  - Prefer matchString (+context) for targeted reading.
  - minified=true (default) reduces tokens.
  - No match found: Returns status: "empty" with hints.
  - Case-sensitive mismatch: Use matchStringCaseSensitive: false.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - matchString: "class UserService", matchStringContextLines: 5
  - matchString: "export.*function", matchStringIsRegex: true
  - fullContent: true, charLength: 5000, charOffset: 0
  </examples>

schema.fullContent: Return entire file. For large files, use with charLength for pagination.
schema.matchString: Search pattern — returns matches with context (token-efficient; pairs well with localSearchCode).
schema.matchStringIsRegex: Treat matchString as regex (default: false for literal).
schema.minified: Minify content for token efficiency (default true).
schema.charLength: Max characters to return (recommend ≤10,000 for large results)

hasResults: Next: trace imports/usages with localSearchCode.
Open related files (tests/types/impl) together.
Prefer matchString over full file.
empty: No match/file. Check path/pattern.
Locate via localFindFiles (name) or localSearchCode (filesOnly for paths).
TIP: Try matchStringIsRegex=true for pattern matching.
TIP: Try matchStringCaseSensitive=false if case-sensitive.

largeFile: Large file: use matchString to extract specific functions/classes.
Alternative: Use charLength for pagination to browse systematically.
Avoid fullContent without charLength on large files.
patternTooBroad: Pattern too broad - tighten pattern or paginate with charLength.
Make the pattern more specific to target only what you need.

localFindFiles.name: localFindFiles
localFindFiles.description:
## Locate files by metadata
  <when>
  - Find files by name, time, size, permissions | Discovery
  - Use when you need paths or recency, not content search.
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Pagination (filesPerPage) | Refine filters
  - localGetFileContent: Read found files
  - localSearchCode: Search content within found files
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - Results sorted by path (no sort param). Use modifiedWithin="7d" to filter recent files.
  - Use type="f" to filter files only (exclude directories).
  - Check "sizeGreater" for large files.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - name: "*.ts", modifiedWithin: "7d", excludeDir: ["node_modules", "dist"]
  - iname: "readme", type: "f"
  - type: "d", pathPattern: "src/**"
  - sizeGreater: "100k", type: "f" (find large files)
  </examples>

schema.name: Name pattern (*.js, *config*).
schema.type: Type: f=file, d=dir, l=symlink, b=block, c=char, p=pipe, s=socket.
schema.filesPerPage: Files per page. See tool schema for defaults/max.
schema.filePageNumber: File page (1-based, default 1). Use with filesPerPage.
schema.showFileLastModified: Show file last modified timestamps in results (default false).

hasResults: Found files. Next: localGetFileContent or localSearchCode.
Use modifiedWithin="7d" to track recent changes.
Batch reads in parallel for efficiency.
empty: No matches. Broaden iname, increase maxDepth, relax filters.
Or use localViewStructure/localSearchCode.
Syntax: time "7d", size "10M".

manyResults: Many results - use filesPerPage to paginate.
Results sorted by path (no sort param). Filter with modifiedWithin for recent files.

localSearchCode.name: localSearchCode
localSearchCode.description:
## Search code patterns
  <when>
  - Find code patterns | Locate files by content | Discovery
  - Use when you know a pattern; need paths + limited context.
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Refine pattern | Switch mode (discovery vs detailed)
  - localGetFileContent: Read full content or specific lines (use charOffset)
  - localViewStructure: Locate file in directory tree
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - AVOID: Broad patterns without filters (too many hits).
  - Discovery: Use filesOnly=true first.
  - Targeted: Use small matchesPerPage.
  - Node_modules: Use noIgnore=true to search ignored files.
  - Multiline is slow.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - pattern: "export function", type: "ts", filesOnly: true
  - pattern: "AuthService", include: ["*.{ts,tsx}"], excludeDir: ["node_modules"], matchesPerPage: 5
  - pattern: "useEffect(", smartCase: true
  - pattern: "express", path: "node_modules/express", noIgnore: true (search inside node_modules)
  </examples>

schema.pattern: Pattern or regex to search (use fixedString for literals)
schema.mode: Search workflow: "discovery" (filesOnly=true), "paginated" (charLength=10000), "detailed" (contextLines=3). Manual params override mode.
schema.fixedString: Treat pattern as literal (fast; -F). No regex interpretation.
schema.wholeWord: Match whole words only (equivalent to \b boundaries)
schema.invertMatch: Invert at LINE level: show non-matching lines. NOTE: Files may still contain pattern. For FILE-level inversion use filesWithoutMatch.
schema.type: File type filter (ts, js, py, rust…). Prefer over globs. See rg --type-list.
schema.include: Include globs. Prefer ["*.{ts,tsx}"] over separate globs.
schema.noIgnore: Ignore .gitignore (search everything). REQUIRED for searching node_modules.
schema.followSymlinks: Follow symbolic links (default false for security).
schema.filesOnly: List matching files only (best for discovery).
schema.filesWithoutMatch: List files that DON'T contain ANY matches (FILE-level inversion). Mutually exclusive with filesOnly.
schema.countMatches: Count total matches across occurrences (vs per-line count).
schema.contextLines: Context lines around matches (0–50). Large values increase output.
schema.matchContentLength: Max chars per match (1–800, default 200). Controls truncation.
schema.maxMatchesPerFile: Max matches per file (legacy; prefer matchesPerPage).
schema.filesPerPage: Files per page. See tool schema for defaults/max.
schema.filePageNumber: File page (1-based, default 1). Use with filesPerPage.
schema.multiline: Enable multiline (slow, memory-heavy). Use only if pattern spans lines.
schema.includeStats: Include search stats (matches, files, bytes, time).
schema.mmap: Use memory mapping (faster on large files).
schema.noUnicode: Disable Unicode mode. Faster on ASCII codebases.
schema.noMessages: Suppress error messages (permission denied, file too large, etc.).
schema.passthru: Print all lines with highlights (can be huge). Conflicts with filesOnly.
schema.debug: Show debug info (ignores, config, strategy, performance).
schema.showFileLastModified: Show file last modified timestamps in results (default false).

hasResults: Next: localGetFileContent for context (prefer matchString).
Also search imports/usages/defs with localSearchCode.
Use location.charOffset with localGetFileContent for precise extraction.
WARNING: charOffset/charLength are BYTE offsets, not character offsets.
empty: No matches. Broaden scope (noIgnore, hidden) or use fixedString.
Unsure of paths? localViewStructure or localFindFiles.
Try semantic variants or different patterns.

largeResult: Large result set - refine search with type/include filters.
Exclude noisy directories: excludeDir (common: test, vendor, generated, __mocks__, fixtures)
Use more specific pattern if current pattern is very short.

localViewStructure.name: localViewStructure
localViewStructure.description:
## Explore directory structure
  <when>
  - Overview directory contents | Understand layout | Discovery
  - Use when: New codebase or unknown locations.
  </when>
  <fromTool>
  - self: Drill deeper (depth) | Pagination (entriesPerPage)
  - localSearchCode: Search content in found directories
  - localFindFiles: Filter by metadata in found directories
  </fromTool>
  <gotchas>
  - AVOID: High depth on root (too many entries). Start with depth=1 or 2.
  - Use hidden=true for dotfiles.
  - sortBy default is "time" (modified time). Use sortBy="name" for alphabetical.
  </gotchas>
  <examples>
  - depth: 1, entriesPerPage: 20
  - pattern: "*.ts", filesOnly: true
  - extensions: ["ts","tsx"], hidden: true
  - path: "node_modules/express", depth: 1 (explore inside node_modules)
  </examples>

schema.entriesPerPage: Entries per page. See tool schema for defaults/max.
schema.entryPageNumber: Entry page (1-based, default 1). Use with entriesPerPage.
schema.pattern: Name filter: globs (*.js, @*, test*) or substring (user).
schema.recursive: Enable recursive tree view (shows all nested content). Combines with depth.
schema.charLength: Max characters to return (recommend ≤10,000 for large results)
schema.showFileLastModified: Show file last modified timestamps in results (default false).

hasResults: Next: localSearchCode for patterns; localFindFiles for filters.
Drill deeper with depth=2 when needed.
Parallelize across directories for efficiency.
empty: Empty/missing. Use hidden=true or check parent.
Discover dirs with localFindFiles type="d".

largeDirectory: Directory has many entries. Use entriesPerPage to paginate.
Use sortBy='time' for recent files; scan page by page.
Start with depth=1 to get overview, then drill into specific subdirectories.

hasResults: Use 'owner', 'repo', 'branch', 'path' fields directly in next tool calls
Follow 'mainResearchGoal', 'researchGoal', 'reasoning', 'hints' to navigate research
Do findings answer your question? If partial, identify gaps and continue
Got 3+ examples? Consider stopping to avoid over-research
Check `pushedAt`/`lastModified` - skip stale content
empty: Try broader terms or related concepts
Remove filters one at a time to find what blocks results
Separate concerns into multiple simpler queries
TOOL TRANSITION: npmSearch ↔ GitHub tools, ghSearchCode ↔ ghSearchRepos
<AGENT_INSTRUCTION>If stuck in loop - STOP and ask user</AGENT_INSTRUCTION>

genericErrorHints: 403? Rate limit - wait 60s or check retry-after header

instructions.base: Bulk response with {count} results: {counts}. Each result includes the status, data, and research details.
instructions.hasResults: Review hasResultsStatusHints for guidance on results with data.
instructions.error: Review errorStatusHints for error recovery strategies.
